steps: Define the DTSR row bit fields as (parent row r, formula index j, restriction word w, branch guard b, Tseitin seed t, child formula id c, occurrence-neighborhood list O_c, and proof-line parent pointers).

Define the closure operator Phi(S): add ordinary bEF dependencies, transparent FormulaEval row supports, and for every reachable DTSR parent in S add every syntactic child Child(r,w,b,t) allowed by the bounded rule, not only the child on the semantic actual branch.

Iterate Phi from the final LB_N line to a least fixed point K_CTSR(pi). Since each line has polynomially bounded visible fanout and bounded DTSR depth, the fixed point is finite and auditable from the transcript.

For each line, maintain a circuit invariant: the parsed circuit computes the line predicate for every completion of the SAT labels on K_CTSR(pi). bEF and FormulaEval cases use the old Gamma_dag proof; the DTSR case is valid because all counterfactual child labels used by the self-reduction identity are already present in K_CTSR(pi).
Charge the DTSR additions by the number of reachable parent rows times the bounded child fanout and occurrence expansion, giving N^{1+kappa+theta+o(1)} in the row-expanded ledger.

If the semantic rule declares only the actual visited branch, choose the first omitted influential sibling. Build two row-label completions agreeing on the transcript and declared rows but differing on that private child; the parent conclusion and hence one carrier parity bit differ. This is the first-unlisted-child falsifier.

Combine the generator circuit, parsed row circuits, and equality patches for E_pi residual rows to obtain C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_CTSR(pi)+O(E_pi N). A subthreshold ledger contradicts the claimed LB_N(1+epsilon) source certificate.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This proves a scoped parser/falsifier boundary for a proof-system interface. It does not prove a lower bound for H_N^SAT, does not separate NP from P/poly, and does not validate hidden semantic FormulaEval without a nonrelativizing realizer.

The declaration list is counterfactually complete: for each reachable parent row the parser can enumerate every possible bounded child row before accepting the semantic self-reduction line.

steps: Define K_B(pi) by a worklist initialized at the final LB_N line; when a line is popped, add its bEF parents, FormulaEval parent pointers, certified row-cover children, output-sensitive enumerator output, and UidxSR_h feasible witnesses.

For ordinary bEF and bounded-SR_h lines, reuse the bit-explicit line induction: each touched occurrence-neighborhood contributes to Gamma_bEF, and annotated SR_h contributes N^{tau+eta+o(1)} row-equivalent debt.

For a transparent FormulaEval line A, run its certificate before A is used, list RowSet(A) or its row cover, and splice the row-expanded bEF derivation with fresh extension variables scoped to the prefix ending at A.

Charge the cost of computing or listing row identifiers to U_N(pi), and charge the expanded SAT-row material to X_N(pi); this gives the invariant that every prefix line has a row-expanded bEF simulation of size at most Gamma_bEF+U_N+X_N for that prefix.
At the final line, combine the expanded proof transcript with G_N to build a nonuniform circuit for H_N^SAT of size N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_BTRS(pi)+O(E_pi N).

If this size is below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, the accepted proof of LB_N(1+epsilon) is refuted by a same-model upper-bound falsifier; otherwise the normalized ledger forces row-equivalent support at least N^{epsilon-o(1)}.

For a support-incomplete semantic line, choose the first omitted reachable row r and build two private-row transcripts agreeing on all charged data but disagreeing at r, showing that the occurrence parser is not valid.
